summary_md: **cv usk ([@cv_usk](https://x.com/cv_usk/status/2115966916229824920))** summarizes *Training Small Language Models for Transferable Tool Selection* ([arXiv 2610.31483](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.31483)): Qwen3 1.7B–8B trained with a Plan-Retrieve-Select pipeline (SFT then GRPO on teacher-filtered ToolBench G3 data) select among 10,000+ tools better than prompting the 402B Llama-4-Maverick, reaching 41.5% G3 success at 8B vs. 30.6%, and swapping BM25 for the dense COLT retriever helps without retraining.
relevance: Small local models can be trained into strong tool selectors.
